_r13b_note: R13 snapshot of the extended grouping, written before the NIST mds2-3402 addition was integrated: it describes the 24-point / six-source dataset and does NOT contain mds2-3402. The R13b leave-one-source run that includes mds2-3402 (54 points, seven sources, nist_mds2_3402 = 30 points, leave-one-source error 61.35%) is recorded in ../output/experiment_v13b_mds2_loso_results.json. No value in this file has been altered.
protocol: Process grouping for leave-one-process cross-validation. Groups are defined by the measured triple (laser power W, scan speed mm/s, layer height um). Each group is a distinct process window; leave-one-process CV holds out one complete window.
note_on_usability: With 6 fully parameterised groups the leave-one-process CV has non-trivial support (the nine v12 points and the three Awd points cannot participate; see ungroupable_sources).

PG5_275W_805mmps_50um.heat_treatment: solution-treated (980 C / 1 h, argon, air cool) - set 1

v12_original.reason: v12 is a COMPILED representative dataset: its values are central values of reported literature ranges from several publications (Carroll 2015 / Wang 2024, Jaskari 2021, Wu 2023) and no single process window (power / scan speed / layer thickness) is defined for it. Cannot be placed in any process group; its nine points participate only in leave-one-source and leave-one-material CV, never in leave-one-process CV.

awd2018metals.reason: The source explicitly states that the SLM scanning parameters are not available for publication ('not available to be published in this work'); no laser power, scan speed or layer thickness can be attributed. Cannot be placed in any process group; must be excluded from leave-one-process CV.
